title: You Cannot Make Everyone Happy
caption:
You cannot make everyone happy. 🫶

Be kind, they call you weak. Be honest, they call you rude. Stay silent, they call you arrogant. Stop shrinking to fit someone else's expectations. The people who truly matter won't ask you to become someone else.

#beyourself #selfrespect #mindset #stickman #reelsinstagram
first_comment: Which one did you hear the most: weak, rude or arrogant? 👇
